canonical_claim: Every closed, connected, orientable three-manifold can be split first by prime decomposition and then along a canonical family of incompressible tori so that every resulting component admits a complete locally homogeneous geometric structure modeled on one of Thurston's eight three-dimensional geometries.
domain_and_universes: A prospective universe-polymorphic type M carrying a concrete topological or smooth three-manifold structure; the exact Lean object model remains open.
quantifiers: M: a closed, connected, orientable three-manifold
prime components produced by an essential-sphere decomposition
geometric components produced by incompressible-torus cuts
conclusion: The prime and torus decomposition pieces carry complete locally homogeneous structures belonging to the eight Thurston model geometries.

alternate_encodings.target: Geometrization stated separately for each irreducible prime component
alternate_encodings.relationship: expected equivalent reformulation after a checked prime-decomposition bridge
strict special consequence, not an equivalent target

excluded_degenerate_cases: Noncompact manifolds, manifolds with boundary, dimensions other than three, and nonorientable variants are outside this frozen root unless a later checked reduction transports them. Poincare alone, hyperbolization alone, or existence of a Ricci flow is not the assigned theorem.
